newsitem.title: USA: Eight dead in Arizona train derailment - official.
newsitem.headline: Eight dead in Arizona train derailment - official.

text.p: At least eight people were killed when an Amtrak passenger train derailed in the northwestern Arizona desert early on Saturday, authorities said.

There were also numerous injuries when the train jumped the Burlington Northern-Sante Fe tracks about 13 miles (21 km) east of Kingman, said Jon Poston, a state Corporation Commission spokesman. The injured were being taken to Kingman Regional Medical Centre.

The train was travelling at approximately 90 mph (145 kph) when it struck a bridge that had been buckled by a severe storm that passed through the area earlier in the evening, a spokeswoman for the Mohave County Sheriff's Department said.
Kingman is about 110 miles (180 km) southwest of Las Vegas.
